reserves.name: Australian-dollar reserves in designated bank accounts

sources.label: Aura Partners AUDX Independent Limited Assurance Report - August 2026

reserveReview.rationale: The August 31, 2026 AUDX Reserve Verification Report records AUD 3,521,466.68 in designated TAU accounts against AUD 3,498,067.00 of AUDX in circulation across seven named chains. Aura Partners' independent limited-assurance report, dated September 22, 2026 and performed under ASAE 3000 and ASAE 3100, obtained independent confirmation of reserve balances directly from the relevant financial institutions, inspected blockchain ledger data, and reconciled reserves to issued supply. Its conclusion found no matter indicating that supply was under-backed; it expressly disclaims an audit opinion. Management states that all reserves are held in segregated, unencumbered accounts. The report identifies the full reserve as designated bank-account balances but does not name financial institutions or disclose account-level allocation. The report's signing date is not treated as its publication date.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Aura Partners independent limited assurance under ASAE 3000/3100 of the AUDX Reserve Verification Report as of August 31, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The report establishes that the full reserve is held in designated bank accounts, but does not name the financial institutions or disclose provider shares and deposit terms.
